description:
Register a content-addressed artifact in a separate provenance DAG.
    Parent hashes may be registered artifacts or external content roots.
    Idempotent on artifact_id; does not consume a genesis index.

artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 of the artifact content, lowercase hex.
artifact_hash.title: Artifact Hash

artifact_id.description: Your id for the artifact; registering it again is idempotent.
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

metadata_digest.description: Optional. SHA-256 of any metadata you keep elsewhere.
metadata_digest.title: Metadata Digest

parent_hashes.description: Optional. Hashes of the inputs it was derived from.
parent_hashes.title: Parent Hashes

producer_agent_id.description: Id of the agent that produced the artifact.
producer_agent_id.title: Producer Agent Id

relation.description: Optional. How it relates to its parents. Default derived_from.
relation.title: Relation

name: register_artifact
title: Register artifact
